name: Sabre Sales Pipeline
report_script:
# 1. تعريف كافة أعمدة الشيت المراد عرضها
columns = [
    {"label": "Type", "fieldname": "opportunity_type", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
    {"label": "Opportunity Owner", "fieldname": "pipeline_am", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "User", "width": 160},
    {"label": "Account Name", "fieldname": "customer", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 180},
    {"label": "Opportunity Name", "fieldname": "name", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sabre Sales Opportunity", "width": 220},
    {"label": "Stage", "fieldname": "workflow_state", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Fiscal Period", "fieldname": "fiscal_period", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 110},
    {"label": "TOV", "fieldname": "opportunity_value", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Weighted Total Opportunity Value (TOV)", "fieldname": "weighted_tov", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Probability (%)", "fieldname": "probability", "fieldtype": "Percent", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Age", "fieldname": "age", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 80},
    {"label": "Close Date", "fieldname": "close_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Created Date", "fieldname": "creation", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 110},
    {"label": "Next Step", "fieldname": "next_step", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Lead Source", "fieldname": "lead_source", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120}
]

# 2. تجهيز أسماء الحقول المراد جلبها بأمان
doc_meta = frappe.get_meta("Sabre Sales Opportunity")
available_fields = [df.fieldname for df in doc_meta.fields] + ["name", "creation"]
desired_fields = [
    "opportunity_type", "pipeline_am", "customer", "name", "workflow_state",
    "fiscal_period", "opportunity_value", "weighted_tov", "probability", "age", 
    "creation", "next_step", "lead_source"
]
fields_to_fetch = [f for f in desired_fields if f in available_fields]

# جلب كافة الفرص أولاً لنقوم بفلترتها بناءً على تواريخها الخارجية
all_opportunities = frappe.get_all("Sabre Sales Opportunity", fields=fields_to_fetch)

# 3. جلب خرائط التواريخ الخارجية من العقود والـ Go-Live وتحويلها لنصوص للمقارنة
contracts = frappe.get_all("Sabre Contract", fields=["opportunity", "contract_date"])
contracts_map = {c.opportunity: str(c.contract_date) for c in contracts if c.opportunity and c.contract_date}

golives = frappe.get_all("Sabre Go-Live", fields=["opportunity", "go_live_date"])
golives_map = {g.opportunity: str(g.go_live_date) for g in golives if g.opportunity and g.go_live_date}

from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")

# 4. دمج التواريخ وتطبيق الفلترة الزمنية الذكية على Close Date
filtered_opportunities = []
for r in all_opportunities:
    opp_name = r.get("name")
    # تحديد تاريخ الإغلاق (إما العقد أو التشغيل)
    detected_close_date = contracts_map.get(opp_name) or golives_map.get(opp_name) or ""
    r["close_date"] = detected_close_date
    
    # منطق الفلترة: إذا وضع المستخدم تواريخ في الواجهة، نقارنها بـ Close Date المكتشف
    keep_row = True
    if from_date or to_date:
        if detected_close_date:
            if from_date and detected_close_date < str(from_date):
                keep_row = False
            if to_date and detected_close_date > str(to_date):
                keep_row = False
        else:
            # إذا كان هناك فلتر نشط والفرصة ليس لها تاريخ إغلاق (عقد أو تشغيل)، يتم إخفاؤها
            keep_row = False
            
    if keep_row:
        filtered_opportunities.append(r)

# 5. توزيع المجموعات بناءً على البيانات المفلترة الجديدة
renewal_rows = []
conversion_rows = []
mix_rows = []
product_rows = []
other_rows = []

for r in filtered_opportunities:
    op_type = r.get("opportunity_type")
    if op_type == "Renewal":
        renewal_rows.append(r)
    elif op_type == "Conversion":
        conversion_rows.append(r)
    elif op_type == "Mix" or op_type == "Mix / Conversion & Renewal":
        mix_rows.append(r)
    elif op_type == "Product":
        product_rows.append(r)
    else:
        other_rows.append(r)

final_rows = []
groups_to_process = [
    ("Subtotal", renewal_rows),
    ("Subtotal", conversion_rows),
    ("Subtotal", mix_rows),
    ("Subtotal", product_rows),
    ("Subtotal", other_rows)
]

for item in groups_to_process:
    label_name = item[0]
    rows_list = item[1]
    if len(rows_list) > 0:
        subtotal_tov = 0
        subtotal_weighted = 0
        
        for row in rows_list:
            final_rows.append(row)
            subtotal_tov += row.get("opportunity_value") or 0
            subtotal_weighted += row.get("weighted_tov") or 0
            
        final_rows.append({
            "opportunity_type": str(label_name),
            "pipeline_am": "Count",
            "customer": str(len(rows_list)),
            "name": "", "workflow_state": "", "fiscal_period": "", 
            "opportunity_value": subtotal_tov,
            "weighted_tov": subtotal_weighted, 
            "probability": "", "age": "", "close_date": "",
            "creation": "", "next_step": "", "lead_source": ""
        })

if len(filtered_opportunities) > 0:
    total_tov = sum(r.get("opportunity_value") or 0 for r in filtered_opportunities)
    total_weighted = sum(r.get("weighted_tov") or 0 for r in filtered_opportunities)
    
    final_rows.append({
        "opportunity_type": "Total",
        "pipeline_am": "Count",
        "customer": str(len(filtered_opportunities)),
        "name": "", "workflow_state": "", "fiscal_period": "", 
        "opportunity_value": total_tov,
        "weighted_tov": total_weighted, 
        "probability": "", "age": "", "close_date": "",
        "creation": "", "next_step": "", "lead_source": ""
    })

data = columns, final_rows
